tagline: Global satellite communications provider connecting people, organizations and assets from anywhere
hero_kpi_rationale: Billable subscribers is a key indicator of the company's growth and market penetration in satellite communications, reflecting global demand for reliable mobile communications services in areas not covered by terrestrial networks.

kpis.name: Billable Subscribers
kpis.explanation: Number of subscribers paying for the company's services
kpis.description: The company had approximately 2.5 million billable subscribers worldwide as of December 31, 2025, an increase of 77,000 or 3% compared to 2.46 million as of December 31, 2024

kpis.name: Service Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the company's services
kpis.description: Service revenue represented 73% of total revenue for the year ended December 31, 2025 and 74% for the year ended December 31, 2024

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.description: Voice and data, IoT data and broadband service revenues have historically generated higher margins than subscriber equipment revenue

kpis.name: Total Revenue

kpis.explanation: Net income divided by the weighted average number of diluted shares outstanding during the fiscal year. Measures the company's ability to generate earnings per share: basis for Payout Ratio calculation (DPS / EPS).
kpis.description: 5-year history (2021-2025). Source: yfinance income statement (Diluted EPS).

risks.title: Cyberattacks
risks.summary: Cyberattacks and other security threats could have a material adverse impact on the company's business
risks.score_rationale: The company explicitly identifies cyberattacks as a major risk, with a dedicated governance structure including a chief information officer, an information security director, and a security risk management committee at the executive level. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.summary: Increased competition could lead to loss of market share and pricing pressure
risks.score_rationale: The company notes growing competition from other satellite service providers, including SpaceX with its announced plans for global D2D services, as well as competition from terrestrial cellular systems. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Technology Dependence
risks.summary: Technical issues or service interruptions could negatively impact the company's operations
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on its constellation of 66 LEO satellites and ground infrastructure, as well as its ability to maintain satellite health, capacity, and control. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Geopolitical Risks
risks.summary: Geopolitical risks, conflicts, and regulatory changes could disrupt the company's operations
risks.score_rationale: The company operates globally, including in regions affected by geopolitical conflicts or natural disasters that could impair terrestrial telecommunications. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Supply Chain Dependence
risks.summary: Supply chain issues could lead to delivery delays and financial losses
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on a global supply chain for components, including sole-source suppliers for most subscriber equipment and certain components, creating vulnerability to supply disruptions. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Financial Risks
risks.summary: Financial risks, reliance on a few major customers, and cash flow difficulties could affect the company's financial stability
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on internal cash flow generation to repay debt and has significant government customers, including U.S. government agencies, for a substantial portion of its revenue. (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: Iridium Communications Inc. (IRDM) has no significant mentions of artificial intelligence or machine learning in the provided excerpts from its 10-K/20-F filings. Its core business focuses on global satellite communications services, positioning, navigation, and timing (PNT), particularly following the acquisition of Satelles in 2024.
